title: Untwisted inverse-image section-cohomology comparisons
statement: Let f:X→T be any scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], F an O_X-module [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], I an injective resolution of F [def-sp-injective-resolutions], q a natural number, and V≤W opens of T. Put Y=(f inverse W).toScheme, G=F restricted to Y, L=the tensor unit, K=f_*I and P=sectionCohomologyPresheaf(K,q) [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Give P(V) its Gamma(T,W)-action by restriction of scalars. For every open U of Y whose image under the inclusion into X is f inverse V, there are additive equivalences e:H^q(U,G)≃P(V) and t:H^q(Y,G)≃P(W) [def-sc-open-module-cohomology]. They commute with restriction from the top open to U and from W to V. For every r in Gamma(T,W), let b be its global pullback on Y and let m_b:G→G be inverse right unitor followed by tensoring with the unit morphism determined by b followed by the right unitor. Then e(H^q(U,m_b)(z))=r e(z). There are no affine, quasi-coherent, compactness or positivity assumptions.

proof.text: Restrict I termwise along (f inverse W).iota. Exact open restriction preserves injectives and the augmentation, hence resolves G. Identify its sections on the top open with I(f inverse W) by restrictAppIso and iota_image_top. Identify its sections on U with I(f inverse V) by restrictAppIso and the given image equality. These are the evaluations of f_*I on W and V. Apply isoRightDerivedObj and mapHomologyIso for exact evaluation to obtain the additive equivalences t and e. This uses the same restricted resolution on both opens, including degree zero and empty opens.

proof.text: The natural transformation of open sections from the top open to U is degreewise restriction. InjectiveResolution.rightDerived_app_eq on the restricted resolution identifies its derived transformation with the homology map of this same restriction. Naturality of restrictAppIso and mapHomologyIso therefore gives e(res(xi)) = P(res)(t(xi)).

proof.text: For r in Gamma(T,W), the unitor-tensor-unitor coefficient endomorphism is multiplication by the global pullback of r on Y. Lift it to every term of the restricted resolution by multiplication by that same global section. Linearity makes this a cochain map extending the coefficient endomorphism. Use isoRightDerivedObj_hom_naturality to compute its derived action. The pinned section-complex comparisons preserve multiplication along pullback of functions, by the explicit degreewise linearity calculation after restriction to U. Naturality of f.app identifies the restricted scalar with the restriction of r to V. Taking homology proves e(H(scalar)(z)) = r e(z). No scalar is assumed invertible.

lean.statement:
theorem sectionCohomology_untwisted_comparisons {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (q : ℕ) (W V : T.Opens) (hV : V ≤ W) :
    let Y := (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme
    let G := (restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj F
    let L := 𝟙_ Y.Modules
    let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let P := sectionCohomologyPresheaf K q
    let : Module Γ(T, W) (P.obj (op V)) :=
      Module.compHom _ (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom
    ∀ (U : Y.Opens), (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ''ᵁ U = f ⁻¹ᵁ V →
      ∃ e : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q U).obj G ≃+
          P.obj (op V),
      ∃ t : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q ⊤).obj G ≃+
          P.obj (op W),
      (∀ (r : Γ(T, W)) (z : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q U).obj G),
        e ((RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q U).map
          ((ρ_ G).inv ≫ G ◁ homOfGlobalSection L
            (unitSectionsEquiv ⊤ (((f.app W) ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).topIso.inv).hom r)) ≫
              (ρ_ G).hom) z) = r • e z) ∧
      (∀ ξ : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q ⊤).obj G,
        e ((RingedSpace.openModuleCohomologyRestriction Y.toRingedSpace q
          (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤))).app G ξ) =
            (P.map (homOfLE hV).op).hom (t ξ))
